name: check_slots
description: Return free appointment times for a date and service. Call before offering any time to the caller.

service.description: Service name as listed in business info

name: book
description: Create a booking and send the caller a WhatsApp confirmation. Only call after confirming name, day, and time with the caller.

name: find_booking
description: Find the caller's existing upcoming booking(s) by phone number.

name: reschedule
description: Move an existing booking to a new time. Confirm the new day and time with the caller first.

name: cancel
description: Cancel an existing booking. Confirm with the caller first.

name: get_rooms
description: Hostels only. Live room availability and fees from HOSTIX.

type.description: Room type, e.g. '1 seater', '2 seater'. Omit for all.

name: transfer
description: Forward the call to the staff number. Use when the caller asks for a human, is angry, or you cannot help. Returns busy if staff does not answer.

name: take_message
description: Save a message for staff and WhatsApp it to the owner. Do not include symptoms or health details.
